result.analyst_notes: Upbeat, aspirational opener ('We are excited about the future') in first-person plural. Financial commitments are the most explicit and absolute ('We are committed to'). Safety and shareholders recur most. Community framing ('Improving Lives') is headline-level but thinly elaborated. History and company facts are factual and carry no values.
